name: CA-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Post-redistricting fundamentals give Democrats a clear structural edge in CA-01
Polymarket prices a Democratic win at roughly 95 percent
Gallagher's incumbency and fundraising only partially offset the district lean

model.rationale: Fundamentals point firmly toward Democrats after redistricting, and markets price this as a near-certain Democratic hold. Gallagher's incumbency and solid fundraising trim the expected margin slightly but not enough to move the race out of Safe D.
model.watch: Any credible general-election polling showing Gallagher running within single digits would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; fundamentals point clearly one way (post-redistricting), so it is treated as safe for that party.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
California's first district was redrawn to lean Democratic, and the fundamentals now point clearly in that direction despite Republican incumbent James Gallagher running for a full term. Gallagher has raised about $1.5 million, but Democrat Mike McGuire has slightly outpaced him and benefits from roughly $600,000 in outside support. No independent expert raters cover the race, and no general-election polls are available.

Prediction markets price a Democratic win at about 95 percent, consistent with the district's structural lean. The forecast treats this as Safe D, with Gallagher's incumbency and fundraising providing only a modest offset to the new district boundaries.
